DT_RISK_LEVEL.description: Optional Dynatrace risk level filter, forwarded to /api/v2/securityProblems as securityProblemSelector=riskLevel(...). Comma-separated combination of: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW. Case-insensitive. Omit to pull every risk level visible to the token.

DT_TIMEFRAME.description: Dynatrace v2 timeframe expression forwarded as the 'from' query parameter on /api/v2/securityProblems. Accepts relative expressions like 'now-30m', 'now-24h', 'now-7d', 'now-30d', 'now-90d' or an ISO-8601 timestamp. Default: now-30d.

name: dynatrace_security
title: Dynatrace Application Security
description: Dynatrace Application Security REST API importer. Lists HOST entities via /api/v2/entities?entitySelector=type(HOST) (for ip / hostname / os enrichment), then security problems via /api/v2/securityProblems (filtered by DT_RISK_LEVEL and DT_TIMEFRAME) and per-problem details via /api/v2/securityProblems/{id}. Emits one Faraday host per Dynatrace HOST entity referenced by an in-scope problem with the problems attached as vulnerabilities; problems whose affected entities do not include any HOST (e.g. only PROCESS_GROUP_INSTANCE / KUBERNETES_CLUSTER references) are attached to a synthetic 0.0.0.0 host so the data is still imported. Severity is normalised from Dynatrace's riskLevel (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) and falls back to CVSS v3 bucketing on the riskScore when only a numeric score is available. Auth is `Authorization: Api-Token <DT_API_TOKEN>` with the `entities.read,securityProblems.read` token scopes; DT_HOST is the Dynatrace tenant base URL (e.g. https://<env-id>.live.dynatrace.com or a Managed cluster URL).
